legend.orange: In progress / mostly working, remaining integration or cleanup

A.summary: Company universe, explicit ratings, G-discovered employers and read-only company learning from canonical I are live.

B.summary: Manual applications reconcile to canonical I as Apply / Applied; B-discovered employers also surface in A as Unrated suggestions.

C.summary: Semantic thesis, Work queues and production C→J bridge are live; ongoing Work recalibration still remains a maintained process.

D.summary: Remote sourcing lane exists but remains secondary and only partially integrated into canonical C.

E.summary: Projects/interim lane exists but the pool is sparse and canonical integration is incomplete.

F.summary: Network/access lane is deferred and no live connection dataset is active.

G.summary: Broad sourcing is live; approved C prioritize guidance can extend search coverage, while source/link quality maintenance remains in progress.

H.summary: Canonical I event evidence and grouped factual summaries are live; confidence-aware attainability inference is still data-limited and not yet feeding decisions.

I.summary: Canonical latest-state history, automatic B reconciliation and append-only lifecycle event log are live; A/C/H factual evidence is regenerated from I.

J.summary: Live J consumes promoted C=Strong + actionable roles with safe fallback and records user decisions into canonical I.

COUNTRY.summary: Country weights are active as soft sourcing and shortlist guidance.

QUALITY.summary: Language/actionability and parser quality gates work; unified live-link/enrichment checks are not complete.
